battle.name: 1805年埃及革命
battle.brief: 一八〇五年三月，埃及的馬穆魯克貝伊趁奧斯曼省府內鬥反攻開羅，奪堡逼宮；朝廷改派阿爾巴尼亞系的穆罕默德·阿里出任瓦利，一八〇七年朝廷遠征軍在三角洲潰散，阿里坐穩埃及。卡面這柄輪發槍代表馬穆魯克家臣騎兵與貝伊侍衛的近身副兵器，只是到一八〇五年，真正的配槍已是燧發手槍。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 一八〇五年的埃及衝突，表層是奧斯曼帝國埃及行省同省內馬穆魯克軍閥的內戰，深層是君士坦丁堡、魯梅利亞新式阿爾巴尼亞兵團同開羅傳統勢力三方爭奪埃及的統治權。帝國一方以總督帕夏為最高指揮，駐開羅的省軍由禁軍與數個奧斯曼營（ojaq）組成，另有從魯梅利亞調來的阿爾巴尼亞募兵擔任攻堅與機動作戰；法國遠征軍撤走後遺留的火槍、銅砲、攻城器材與少數法籍技術人員，成了這批新軍裝備的來源。馬穆魯克一方以「國家首長」為尊，旗下是按家族編成的家臣騎兵團，各貝伊各有數百至數千人，裝備以火繩槍、長矛、彎刀為主，家臣騎兵亦配手槍，遇攻守則倚靠市區街壘與城內清真寺、宗學學者構成的支援網；上埃及的鄉村與下埃及的海關口岸（羅塞塔、杜姆亞特）是兩處資源地，誰控制開羅與港口，誰就控制解稅與徵兵。第三方是君士坦丁堡本身：朝廷在震驚之後改以阿爾巴尼亞系將領穆罕默德·阿里取代原有總督，等於在省內兩股力量之外再插入一支配衡的第三極；法國在埃及留下的工程人員與少數技術兵員，同樣左右了火器與砲術的傳播。
countriesEn: The conflict of 1805 in Egypt was, on the surface, a civil war between the Ottoman province of Egypt and the Mamluk beys who kept armed households of their own inside it; underneath, it was a three-way struggle over who would govern Egypt, pitting the Porte at Constantinople, the new Albanian (Rumelian) mercenary army, and the traditional power of Cairo. On the imperial side the highest command was the pasha appointed as wali; the provincial garrison in Cairo was made up of the Janissaries and several Ottoman ojaq regiments, while Albanian recruits raised in Rumelia provided the shock troops and the mobile force. The muskets, bronze guns, siege material and a handful of French technicians left behind by the French expedition after its withdrawal became the equipment pool of these new formations. On the Mamluk side the dignity of shaykh al-balad was the recognised title of precedence, and beneath it lay households mustered by family: every bey raised from several hundred to several thousand riders armed mainly with matchlock muskets, lances and curved sabres, the household cavalry also carrying pistols; when attacked or besieged they relied on street barricades inside the city and on the support network formed by the ulama and the Islamic scholars of the towns. The villages of Upper Egypt and the customs ports of Lower Egypt, Rosetta and Damietta, were the two resource bases, and whoever held Cairo and the ports held the tax and the recruits as well. The third party was the Porte itself: after the shock of the revolt it replaced the governor with the Albanian commander Muhammad Ali, inserting a third balancing pole between the two local powers; the French engineers and a few French technical soldiers left over from the occupation likewise mediated the spread of firearms and artillery practice.
people: 關鍵人物可分四類。第一是馬穆魯克領袖艾哈邁德·阿加·宰達哈比，他在一八〇五年初率家臣兵起兵，奪取開羅的控制權，隨後被自己人所殺，他的死令局面更形混亂；其子蘇萊曼·阿加在上埃及起兵更早，一八〇五年初在與總督軍隊的交戰中身亡，具體經過各家記載不一。其二是奧斯曼總督赫爾希德·艾哈邁德帕夏，他以有限的阿爾巴尼亞兵鎮壓上埃及的反抗，同時四面受敵；宗教領袖兼「國家首長」人選烏馬爾·馬克拉姆則是一八〇一年穆罕默德·阿里的盟友，一八〇九年被放逐到杜姆亞特。其三是受命收拾殘局的穆罕默德·阿里：這位生於卡瓦拉、在法軍撤出後的混亂中靠阿爾巴尼亞同鄉兵站穩腳跟的指揮官，一八〇五年三月被任命為埃及瓦利，六月抵達開羅，隨即以「埃及第一人」的名義接手省務；一八〇七年朝廷派來遠征的阿爾巴尼亞軍由優素福·齊亞帕夏率領，最終在三角洲敗散。其四是開羅的烏萊瑪（宗學學者）與商人集團，他們在馬穆魯克與奧斯曼之間穿梭說合，最終把穆罕默德·阿里推上前線，因為他們要的不是任何一方真正獨霸埃及，而是一個能壓住各方、又聽得懂他們說話的總督。
peopleEn: Four kinds of decisive figure appear in the story. First, the Mamluk leader Ahmad Agha al-Dhahabi, who raised the households of his own following in early 1805, seized control of Cairo, and was then killed by men of his own circle, his death leaving the situation more confused still; his son Sulayman Agha had risen earlier in Upper Egypt and fell in the opening months of 1805 in an engagement with the governor's troops, the details of which differ from one account to another. Second, the Ottoman governor Khurshid Ahmad Pasha, who tried to crush the revolt in Upper Egypt with a limited Albanian force while being pressed on every side; Umar Makram, a religious leader and a candidate for the dignity of shaykh al-balad, had been Muhammad Ali's ally in 1801 and was exiled to Damietta in 1809. Third, Muhammad Ali, the man sent to pick up the pieces: a commander born in Kavala who had held his place among his Albanian comrades during the disorder that followed the French withdrawal, appointed wali of Egypt in March 1805 and in Cairo by June, from which point he took over provincial government in the name of 'the first of Egypt'; the Albanian army the Porte sent to depose him in 1807 was led by Yusuf Ziya Pasha and was finally scattered in the delta. Fourth, the ulama and the merchant bodies of Cairo, who shuttled between the Mamluks and the Ottomans and finally thrust Muhammad Ali to the front, because what they wanted was not for any side to monopolise Egypt but a governor able to hold every faction down and able to understand their language.
kits: 卡面上那柄輪發槍，是十五世紀西班牙與義大利工匠造出的後膛手槍，靠發條絞緊的機件擊發燧石點火；火繩槍兵為了好帶火繩而放棄了後膛機件，輪發槍的優點正是免帶火繩、可以騎在馬上連續射擊，缺點則是機件昂貴、容易損壞，而且每打一發都要重新上弦。到了十九世紀初的埃及，這種機件早已被燧發手槍取代；真正陪著馬穆魯克貝伊上陣的是燧發手槍、火繩手槍、長管火槍、馬穆魯克式彎刀、長矛與小圓盾，攻城一方另有銅砲、臼砲與輕型攻城器材。火器的來源本身就是一場角力：火繩槍多是舊存與本地仿製，燧發槍則靠歐洲商人經亞歷山大港與紅海輸入，價格隨航路與政局上下浮動，開羅城內亦有軍械庫與鑄砲場。開羅的城防沿用舊式雉堞與城門，火砲壞位不高，能守不能攻；兵員的訓練與裝備在各方之間差異極大，這正是阿爾巴尼亞兵與馬穆魯克家臣騎兵互有勝負的原因。卡面這柄輪發槍的意義，在於把「手槍」這類只配給軍官、貝伊侍衛與家臣騎兵長的近身副兵器放回它應有的位置：它屬於最早一批解決後膛點火的手槍，是手槍作戰價值的原始版本，儘管到一八〇五年，這個具體機件已淪為舊式樣式，類型本身卻仍在埃及的家臣騎兵與衛兵手上延續。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol on the card face is a breech-loading handgun built by fifteenth-century craftsmen in Spain and Italy, in which a spring-driven mechanism releases a flint to strike the priming pan; the musketeers had given up on breech mechanisms because of the slow match they had to carry, and the merit of the wheellock was precisely that it needed no match and could be fired from the saddle, while its defects were cost, fragility and the need to crank the mechanism again after every shot. By the opening years of the nineteenth century in Egypt that mechanism had long been superseded by the flintlock; what actually went into the line with the Mamluk beys was flintlock and matchlock pistols, long muskets, the Mamluk curved sabre, the lance and the small round shield, while on the siege side there were bronze guns, mortars and light siege equipment. The sources of the weapons were themselves a subject of contention: matchlocks were old stock or locally copied, while flintlocks came in through European merchants by way of Alexandria and the Red Sea, their prices rising and falling with the shipping routes and with the politics; inside Cairo there were an arsenal and a gun-casting yard. The defences of Cairo kept to old-style battlements and gates whose guns had low embrasures, good enough to hold a city but not to take one, and the training and equipment of the troops differed sharply from corps to corps, which is why the Albanian infantry and the Mamluk household cavalry could each win against the other. The meaning of the wheellock on the card is that it puts the pistol back in the place it belongs: a close-quarters sidearm issued only to officers, to a bey's personal guard and to the leaders of the household cavalry, and the first generation of breech-loading handguns to solve the problem of ignition. By 1805 this particular mechanism had become an old pattern, yet the type itself continued on the hips of the household cavalry and the guards in Egypt.
tactics: 馬穆魯克的戰法以家臣為單位，不追求會戰殲滅，而以奪點、斷糧、扼水道為主：控制開羅城堡與城內軍械庫，佔領尼羅河上的橋樑與渡口，讓總督的稅船與軍糧船無法靠岸；上埃及與下埃及的據點，靠騎兵一日可達的距離互相呼應，任何一支分隊都沒有被全殲的機會。奧斯曼方面則把阿爾巴尼亞步兵排成密集方陣，用火槍齊射壓制，再以短兵接戰，靠人數與行軍速度換取會戰勝算；圍城時採用封鎖配合砲擊，讓糧盡與困守替自己做事，而切斷羅塞塔與杜姆亞特的徵稅通道，等於直接切掉省府一半收入。開羅城內的攻防是另一種戰法：街壘、清真寺與族裔街區令騎兵無處施展，阿爾巴尼亞步兵則佔住屋頂與巷口，用火槍封住街線，把騎兵擋在城外。尼羅河三角洲的沼澤、村落與灌溉渠是雙方都會利用的障礙：冬季水淺可以涉水通過，夏季水漲只能靠船，因此河運與海運成為補給的關鍵。穆罕默德·阿里接手後做法十分明確，他把阿爾巴尼亞兵團分駐要衝與港口，以小股騎兵巡邏封鎖鄉間道路，逼迫馬穆魯克分散成小股，再逐一以優勢兵力吃掉。
tacticsEn: The Mamluk way of war was organised by household and did not seek a set-piece annihilation; it aimed at seizing points, cutting supplies and strangling the water route: hold the Citadel of Cairo and the arsenal inside the city, seize the bridges and the fords of the Nile so that the governor's tax-boats and grain-boats cannot come alongside, and link the posts of Upper and Lower Egypt at a distance a horseman can cover in a single day, so that no detachment is easily wiped out. The Ottomans answered with Albanian infantry drawn up in dense ranks, firing muskets in volleys to crush the enemy and then closing hand to hand, trading on numbers and on marching speed for a decision in the field; against a defended city they combined blockade with cannon fire, letting hunger and the slow squeeze do part of the work for them, and cutting the tax route through Rosetta and Damietta struck at half the revenue of the province at a stroke. Fighting inside Cairo was a business of another kind: street barricades, mosques and the quarters of the different clans left the cavalry no room to work, while the Albanian infantry took the roofs and the mouths of the alleys, sealing the streets with their muskets and keeping the horsemen outside the walls. The marshes, the villages and the irrigation canals of the Nile delta were obstacles both sides used: in the shallow winter season the ground could be forded, in the summer flood only boats could pass, which made river and coastal transport the key of supply. After taking over, Muhammad Ali's method was clear enough: he quartered his Albanian regiments on the passes and the ports, sent small cavalry patrols to seal the country roads, and forced the Mamluks to scatter into small bodies that could then be eaten up one at a time by superior force.
data: 關於這場戰事的數字，史料留下的極少，諸說並存，只能作量級上的把握。馬穆魯克人口與家臣總數，十八世紀末通常被估計在上、下埃及合計一萬至兩萬名騎手之間（含各貝伊零散家臣），而實際能同時集結作戰的往往只是其中一部份；單一貝伊的家臣常在數百人上下，家臣與主人的關係是私屬性質，平日散居鄉村與城郊，遇事才集結。奧斯曼省軍連同禁軍在開羅一帶的常備兵力，通常被說是數千人規模，阿爾巴尼亞新軍團以營為編制單位，總數亦在數千上下。穆罕默德·阿里一八〇五年六月進駐開羅時所帶的兵力，各家記載多落在四五千人這個量級；一八〇七年朝廷派出的阿爾巴尼亞遠征軍同樣是數千人。就時間線而言：法軍佔領一七九八至一八〇一年，省內內鬥一八〇一至一八〇五年，開羅奪權在一八〇五年三月，阿里到任一八〇五年六月，朝廷遠征在一八〇七年，阿里遣使入京則在一八〇九年。就地理尺度看，開羅至羅塞塔約一百一十公里，開羅至杜姆亞特約一百六十公里，開羅至亞歷山大約一百八十公里，騎兵急行軍可在數日內往返；但戰鬥多在城牆與街巷方圓數公里內反覆拉鋸，時間以週、以月計，而不是以日計。關於死傷，馬穆魯克方面的損失在阿爾巴尼亞遠征軍潰敗後尤為慘重，阿里事後下令收繳家臣武裝，具體數目未見可靠記載，本篇不作估算。
dataEn: Figures for this conflict are scarce and the accounts disagree, so they can only be taken as orders of magnitude. The Mamluk population and the total of their households at the end of the eighteenth century are usually put between ten and twenty thousand riders in Upper and Lower Egypt together (including the scattered households of every bey), while the part that could actually be brought together to fight at any one time was only a fraction of that; a single bey's household commonly numbered several hundred, and the bond between household and master was of a private character, the riders living scattered over the villages and the outskirts and assembling only when there was need. The standing provincial force together with the Janissaries in and around Cairo is usually described as numbering some thousands, and the new Albanian formations, organised in companies, were likewise counted in the thousands. The force Muhammad Ali brought with him when he entered Cairo in June 1805 is given by different writers at between four and five thousand men; the Albanian expedition dispatched by the Porte in 1807 was of a similar scale. As for the timetable: the French occupation ran from 1798 to 1801, the civil war inside the province from 1801 to 1805, the seizure of Cairo fell in March 1805, Ali's arrival in June 1805, the Ottoman expedition in 1807, and Ali's first embassy to Constantinople in 1809. In terms of distance, Cairo to Rosetta is about a hundred and ten kilometres, Cairo to Damietta about a hundred and sixty and Cairo to Alexandria about a hundred and eighty, so a horseman could ride the round in a matter of days; the fighting itself, however, was fought within a few kilometres of the walls and streets and lasted for weeks and months at a time rather than for days. As for losses, the Mamluks suffered most severely after the Albanian expedition was routed, and Ali afterwards ordered the households disarmed; the exact numbers are not reliably recorded, and this account offers no estimate.
cause: 起因有三層。最外層是法國遠征軍一七九八至一八〇一年佔領埃及後留下的權力真空：法軍撤走時帶走了埃及自己的行政與軍事骨幹，土耳其人與馬穆魯克同時撲向空出的位置，兩邊都自認有權接管。往內是奧斯曼中央的集權企圖：朝廷不滿馬穆魯克貝伊壟斷稅收與武裝，逐步派駐阿爾巴尼亞兵團收回權力，於是省內形成「中央要收權、地方要保權」的正面衝突；稅收的分配正是核心，朝廷要求省府解足稅額，貝伊靠代收、包辦與私產養活自己的家臣，誰控制開羅，誰就控制解稅與徵兵的人頭。最深一層是馬穆魯克傳統本身的分裂：十八世紀以來貝伊之間為爭奪「國家首長」位子內鬥不絕，任何一方勝利都意味著失敗者的家臣被拆散、性命交給新主，這使得開羅每一次換總督都等於一場全面重洗牌。直接導火線是一八〇五年初蘇萊曼·阿加在上埃及的起兵被鎮壓身亡，父親艾哈邁德·阿加隨後在開羅反戈、奪取城堡，衝突由省內的權力競逐升級為公開的反叛。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The outermost is the power vacuum left by the French occupation of Egypt between 1798 and 1801: when the French withdrew they took away the administrative and military backbone of Egypt itself, and Turks and Mamluks rushed at the same moment towards the vacant place, each side believing it had the right to take over. Inside that lies the centralising drive of the Porte, which grew tired of the Mamluk beys monopolising the taxes and the armed force and posted Albanian regiments step by step to take the power back, so that the province found itself with a head-on clash between a central authority that wanted to collect and local lords who wanted to keep; the distribution of the revenue was the core of it, for the Porte demanded that the province remit its full quota while the beys kept their households alive on collection, farming and private estates, and whoever held Cairo held the tax and the head-count of recruits. Deepest of all is the fragmentation of the Mamluk tradition itself: since the eighteenth century the beys had killed one another over the office of shaykh al-balad, and any victory meant that the loser's households were broken up and their lives handed over to the new master, so that every change of governor in Cairo amounted to a complete reshuffling of the whole order. The immediate spark was the revolt of Sulayman Agha in Upper Egypt in the opening months of 1805, which was crushed and in which he was killed; his father Ahmad Agha al-Dhahabi then turned on the governor in Cairo and seized the Citadel, raising a contest for power inside the province into an open rebellion.
impact: 直接影響是埃及的統治權數易手：馬穆魯克家臣在一八〇五年的勝負之後漸漸被拆散，奧斯曼朝廷以穆罕默德·阿里為瓦利，把省政交給一支阿爾巴尼亞系的職業軍隊，此後數十年埃及的軍隊不再是馬穆魯克騎兵的家臣兵，而是蘇丹式常備軍與受訓步槍兵；一八〇七年朝廷自己的阿爾巴尼亞遠征軍被穆罕默德·阿里打敗，一八〇九年後他遣使到君士坦丁堡求確認，阿里王朝由此起。間接影響更大：歐洲觀察家發現，奧斯曼帝國出現了一個願意且能夠在埃及推行火器改革、徵兵、土地與農業稅制的省督，這套做法後來被稱為埃及式的改革，隨著他的軍隊與使節走遍蘇丹、阿拉伯、敘利亞與希臘，成為十九世紀中東最積極的一次軍事與社會變革；其中招募法國教官與本地工匠重編步槍兵、砲兵的做法，令「歐洲式軍事改革」在中東第一次有了一個本地政權做樣板。對馬穆魯克階級而言，身份由軍事力量轉為官銜與莊園，貴族式的生活延續到近代埃及的上流；對馬穆魯克制度本身則是終局：一八〇五年失去的自主空間，在一八一一年開羅城堡對他們的武力清剿中徹底結束。
impactEn: The immediate effect was a change of hands in the government of Egypt: after the outcome of 1805 the Mamluk households were gradually broken up, and the Porte, with Muhammad Ali as wali, handed provincial government to a professional Albanian army. For the decades that followed, the forces of Egypt were no longer the household cavalry of the beys but a sultani standing army and infantry drilled with the musket; the Porte sent its own Albanian expedition in 1807 and it was beaten by Muhammad Ali, who afterwards sent embassies to Constantinople to have his position confirmed, and the dynasty of Ali dates from that. The indirect effect is larger still: European observers found in the Ottoman Empire a provincial governor who was both willing and able to carry out a reform of firearms, of conscription, of land and of the agricultural tax in Egypt. That package became known as the Egyptian style of reform, and as his troops and his envoys travelled through Sudan, Arabia, Syria and Greece it turned into the most energetic military and social transformation of the middle east in the nineteenth century; within it, the enlistment of French instructors and local craftsmen to rebuild the musketeers and the gunners gave the European style of military reform, for the first time in the middle east, a local government to serve as its model. For the Mamluk class, rank passed from military power to title and estate, and an aristocratic manner of life ran on into the upper ranks of modern Egypt; for the Mamluk order itself it was the end: the room for independent action they lost in 1805 was finished off entirely in the armed roundup of the Mamluks in the Citadel of Cairo in 1811.
result: 結局分三段。一八〇五年三月，開羅的馬穆魯克一度奪權，艾哈邁德·阿加入主城堡並被自己的部屬所殺，蘇萊曼·阿加此前已在上埃及陣亡，馬穆魯克的全面反叛實際上以內部分裂收場；朝廷乘機改立穆罕默德·阿里為瓦利，他於六月抵達開羅。一八〇七年的高潮則由阿里取得：朝廷派來的阿爾巴尼亞遠征軍在三角洲一役潰散，遠征者退回君士坦丁堡，阿里得到開羅與全省的實權，馬穆魯克貝伊失去直屬武力，只能靠職銜維持體面，其殘部則被收編進阿爾巴尼亞兵團。一八〇九年朝廷要求阿里交出部分馬穆魯克首腦，他用拖延與放逐應付，到一八一一年三月，城堡中的馬穆魯克被集中清剿，數百年的騎兵傳統在幾日之間落幕，埃及再沒有一支能同奧斯曼中央談判的本地軍事勢力。對這場「革命」本身而言，結果是失敗的：起義者奪得的城堡與權位，沒有轉化為獨立的國家機器，反而成為新政權接管埃及的契機；於是這場一八〇五年三月開打的衝突，成為埃及近代軍政改革的起點，也成為奧斯曼帝國在北非的權威崩解的開端——卡面這柄輪發槍所代表的舊秩序，軍官自帶副兵器、馬穆魯克以家臣騎兵治國的時代，至此收場。
resultEn: The outcome came in three stages. In March 1805 the Mamluks of Cairo seized power for a moment; Ahmad Agha al-Dhahabi entered the Citadel and was killed by his own followers, while Sulayman Agha had already fallen in Upper Egypt, and the great Mamluk rebellion in fact ended in internal division. The Porte took advantage and appointed Muhammad Ali as wali, who reached Cairo in June. The climax came in 1807 and went to Ali: the Albanian expedition sent by the Porte was routed in the delta, the expeditionaries drew back to Constantinople, and Ali gained effective power over Cairo and over the whole province, while the Mamluk beys, deprived of their own armed households, could keep nothing but the dignity of their titles, their remnants being taken into the Albanian regiments. In 1809 the Porte demanded that Ali hand over certain Mamluk leaders; he answered with delay and exile, and by March 1811 the Mamluks in the Citadel were rounded up and destroyed, a tradition of horsemen several centuries old ended within a matter of days, and Egypt no longer had a local military force able to bargain with the Ottoman centre. For this 'revolution' itself the result was a defeat: what the insurgents won in the Citadel and in office was never turned into an independent state, and instead became the pretext by which the new authority took over Egypt. The clash that opened in March 1805 thus became the starting point of the modern military and administrative reform of Egypt, and the opening breach in the authority of the Ottoman Empire in North Africa; the old order that the wheellock on the card stands for, officers carrying their own sidearms and the Mamluks ruling through their household cavalry, ended with it.
